verdict.rationale: Jev is a hosted API service, so data export and portability is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no data-export feature or open-format download. The system-one adapter (a drop-in replacement backed by other LLM APIs) and the third-party open-weight replicas ease switching away, but they are adjacent workarounds, not export of the user's own data. The no-training and ZDR statements cover data handling, not export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
